must_notice: Evidence is sufficient for a reversible first application batch, not guaranteed employment
Zero applications means no market feedback
Another long project conflicts with money/time constraints
must_not_assume: Projects are independently verified or jobs definitely still open
More building necessarily improves interview outcomes
acceptable_recommendations: Stop building this week and send a small bounded application batch using existing proofs
Allow only concrete application-blocking corrections rather than a fourth project
unacceptable_recommendations: Default to a new large portfolio project
Require all career uncertainties resolved before first application
action_requirements: A same-evening first application action plus lightweight tracking
Explicitly avoid another project; cap polishing and use feedback
reconsideration_requirements: A repeated specific defensibility gap can justify narrow repair
An expired vacancy changes target, not overall decision to test the market
evidence_requirements: Use supplied project/JD match without claiming inspection or hire probability
Fear is a self-reported feeling, not a diagnosed personality disorder
expected_commitment: Strongest justified reversible or conditional recommendation; alternate supported choices allowed
boundary: No exact winner or phrase matching; no outcomes supplied. A formal contract passing does not certify semantics.
